opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode's intense, darkly comedic depiction of reckless decision-making.
Some praised the show's apparent research and its detailed treatment of foreign-exchange concepts.
A number of viewers found the character-focused tension entertaining and said the series remains a seasonal favorite.
Commenters viewed the characters as compelling but frustrating, especially because their confidence and impulsiveness make them difficult to support.
Several reactions described the episode as stressful or physically uncomfortable to watch because of the characters' poor judgment.
Some felt the central character's behavior was increasingly irresponsible and driven more by emotion or luck than sound reasoning.
